newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down amid position-squaring on Tuesday's settlement day, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 7.23 points, or 0.47 percent, down at 1,546.42.

Profit-taking in the bellwether stock of Pakistan Telecommunication Ltd (PTCL) pulled the index down, one broker said. The merger of Brooke Bond in Lever Bros had only a slight impact on the two stocks.
PTCL fell 0.40 rupee to 25.40. Brooke Bond rose five to 170 and Lever Bros two to 722. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
